firstPlayerRule: The dealer starts: they take a card from the deck, then pass one card face down to the left. Everyone then passes to the left at the same time.
houseFallback: The page does not say who deals; use the picker.

sources.title: Spoons — How to Play

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Spoons page in a browser. "The dealer takes a card off the top of the deck to have five cards in their hand, removes one and passes it face down to the left. Each player discards to the person on their left."
uncertainty: The page does not say how the dealer is chosen.
